dns.exact_quote: dial tcp: lookup checkoutservice on 169.254.20.10:53: no such host

claims.assessment: Supported at observed failure-mechanism level: frontend lookup of checkoutservice fails with no such host. Does not identify the underlying DNS misconfiguration or prove persistent current fault.

Identifies the name being resolved and affected dependency. It does not establish that fault ownership is in the checkoutservice application rather than resolver, client namespace/configuration, or a transient record-availability problem.
